assumptions: Costs are user estimates, not observed charges
Resolution and spendable proceeds are separated by configured delay
No empirically calibrated fill probability or queue priority

selection: Minimum mean validation source-group RMSE by family; prefer ridge within 0.005 virtual USD RMSE. Representative seed has minimum validation RMSE. No policy promotion.
final_test: Keep all new tests unopened until weights and validation selection are frozen and exported. Any later evaluation requires a separate recorded plan.
hypothesis: Decision-time observations may predict initial-position simulated friction more accurately than constant and quoted full-fill estimates.
limitations: Synthetic estimated frictions only; not settlement loss or real fee calibration
Fixed declared costs within cohort; later portfolio states and recovery orders excluded
Generated scenario variants are correlated; confidence denominators use source groups
